text:
maya: Heads-up — saw a tenant get 429s when primary model saturated in us-west. Console showed "oom" and then dropped requests. Is that expected with current fallback policy?

arjun: We only trigger fallback when the slot pool reports 'saturated' AND a compatible variant is available. Looks like the tenant hit the saturation threshold and fallback wasn't eligible.

maya: Why not eligible? Region mismatch or variant compat check? They were on Dedicated us-west.

elaine: Current logic: prefer same-region compatible variant, then cross-region if tenant.allow_cross_region=true. If tenant has region_restriction=true we decline cross-region. Also we require model semantic compatibility >= 0.9.

sam: Console UX confusion — dashboard shows 'model saturated' but no indication that auto-fallback is off. Ops asked for a clear "Auto-fallback disabled" badge and link to why.

devon: Also +1 telemetry: emit reasons for fallback decisions. E.g. routing.fallback.reason = one of ["no_variant", "region_blocked", "quota_block", "compat_fail"] so support can triage.

maya: Proposal: introduce a new policy mode `capacity_aware` with explicit config: 
```
fallback_policy: capacity_aware
spill_threshold: 0.95   # start spilling at 95% occupancy
allow_cross_region: tenant_config.allow_cross_region || false
compatibility_score_cutoff: 0.8
prefer_cost_saving: true
```
This prefers same-region, then same-tier cross-region, then lower-tier best-effort. Also allow tenant override.

arjun: Love it. Small ask — add a `cost_priority` flag so we don't swap to a variant >2x cost unless latency SLO is threatened.

elaine: Console should show the *effective* fallback policy per tenant and a "preview route" button that simulates where a request would go given current capacity snapshot. That will help support explainability.

maria: For rollout: canary 1% tenants, 24h. Track metrics: routing.fallback.count, routing.fallback.success, routing.fallback.latency_delta, routing.fallback.cost_delta, errors.per_minute, customer-impacted-traces.

ops-bot: deploy-check — capacity_aware policy schema v1 validated, no schema errors, quota checks: 0 warnings.

sam: UX wireframe idea: in the routing row add an inline pill: "Auto-fallback: ON • same-region preferred" with hover explaining rules and an action to disable per-route. If disabled show "Auto-fallback disabled — cross-region/variant swap blocked".

devon: API suggestion: support `X-Redwood-Fallback-Hint` header values: `prefer_lower_cost` | `prefer_latency` | `no_cross_region`. Router should treat hint as a soft preference.

maya: Action items:
  1) API + header spec (devon)
  2) Console badge + preview + wireframes (elaine + sam)
  3) Telemetry events & Grafana dashboard (maria)
  4) Canary rollout plan + metrics + alert thresholds (arjun)
I’ll open the policy PR and a console mockup later today.

arjun: Assign PR to eng-routing, cc @security for cross-region implications.

maya: Logging note: tag fallback events with tenant_id and trace_id and include `routing.fallback.reason` so support can reproduce easily. :thumbsup:

sam: One more: expose aggregated metric `routing.fallback.cost_delta_7d` so finance can estimate monthly impact before enabling broadly.

maya: Great — thanks everyone. I’ll post the PR link here once ready.
